# Renewals steering, 10 October

Attendees: Aoife Brennan, Tomasz Wielgosz, Rhys Calloway, Ellie Thornbury, Nora Kestrel, Hannah Varga

- Both clubs ran member surveys in September. 23% of Kingsport FC season ticket holders and 19% at Harbour Athletic said they would not renew if they had to pay the full price in one go.
- Both finance teams now accept direct debit if the payment provider handles the mandates.

**Decision:** for the 2027 renewals we offer direct debit in 10 monthly instalments alongside card payment. This replaces the March decision that season tickets are card only. Mandates are held by the payment provider's direct debit product, so we still store no bank details ourselves.

Actions
- Tomasz: estimate the instalments work by 17 October.
- Nora: re-plan the project timeline.
